parsed.rationale: Although `StreamingService.name` (package `Metadata`, line 20) and `MusicServiceIdentifier.displayName` (package `MusicShareKit`, line 76) share a high Jaccard similarity of 0.875, they are computed properties on two distinct domain types in two distinct packages. `StreamingService.name` describes a streaming service entity, while `MusicServiceIdentifier.displayName` describes a music-service identifier attached to a track model. The structural similarity is almost certainly coincidental — both are simple string-returning computed properties whose bodies happen to look alike — rather than evidence of shared logic that should be unified. Merging them would couple `Metadata` and `MusicShareKit` for no semantic gain, and the `shared_field_count: 0` confirms there is no shared data model underpinning the similarity.
